prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic beige fashion editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on a neutral studio floor.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long voluminous dark-brown waves, natural glam makeup, calm confident direct gaze and realistic skin texture. She wears an ivory-beige halter wrap top and matching flowing high-waisted skirt with soft translucent layers, plus supplied gold bangles and studs. A supplied cigarette may be included only as a non-emphasized lifestyle prop with no smoke inhalation or health claims.
composition_elements: Medium-full seated portrait with one knee raised toward the camera, the other leg folded beneath, torso slightly angled and hand resting near the knee.
Soft beige wall panels, smooth neutral floor and shallow background depth.
Preserve ivory palette, layered skirt movement, jewelry, pose and hazy atmosphere.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused front-left key light with subtle fill and gentle rim light on hair, warm ivory grading, delicate haze and natural shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.0, sharp eyes and face, realistic skin, chiffon and gold texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
